verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Marqeta's card-issuing APIs (card products, users, cards), a sandbox and transaction simulation, but nothing addresses this story's core. There is no mention of BIN sponsorship, issuing-bank partners, card network membership, managed program-management services, or a documented timeline from signup to a first live card. The sandbox docs only state that sandbox cards cannot transact on real networks. Card-creation APIs belong to a separate issuance story and do not show that the platform takes on the bank and network obligations.
